🇺🇸 US Economic Offers Fail to Shift Russia's Position Financial Times reports that Washington failed to convince Moscow to accept a peace deal via major business agreements. Russia showed no interest in proposed joint projects in energy and aviation, viewing them as insufficient incentives. Following talks in Abu Dhabi, the US shifted focus from economic cooperation to territorial issues and security guarantees. Sources indicate Russia continues to insist on Ukraine ceding Donbass. Officials concluded that economic proposals cannot alter Vladimir Putin's stance, though post-war cooperation remains part of negotiations. Separately, FT journalist Miller argues European allies must intensify support for Kiev to prevent escalation, urging stronger AD systems for Ukraine and tighter sanctions on Russia's 'shadow fleet' and military economy. @Slavyangrad

🇷🇺 🇳🇬 November 25 marks the 6️⃣ 6️⃣ th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between our country and the Federal Republic of Nigeria. On October 1, 1960, the Nigerian people cast off the shackles of British colonial rule . The Soviet Union was among the first countries to establish diplomatic relations with the newly independent African state. The Soviet Union provided Nigeria with substantial assistance and support in building its national institutions, strengthening socio-economic stability and assisting the transition from an agrarian and resource-dependent territory to one of Africa's largest and self-reliant economies. 🤝 #Nigeria is one of the key partners of the Russian Federation. Today, our countries continue to steadily expand cooperation in the political, trade and economic, humanitarian and other fields. Russian-Nigerian relations have traditionally been friendly in nature and continue to develop on the basis of equality , mutual respect and consideration for each other's interests. Both countries expand business contacts and implement joint projects in the fields of energy, mineral extraction and processing, agriculture, construction, and infrastructure development and modernisation. The Intergovernmental Commission on Trade and Economic Cooperation continues to operate on a regular basis. 🌐 #MultipolarWorld : Our countries are committed to promoting the emergence of a more just and democratic world order — the tendency reflecting the steady increase in the economic, financial and political weight of the countries of the #GlobalSouth and the #GlobalEast in the international arena. Moscow and Abuja share the conviction that it is essential to overcome the remnants of neo-colonial practices in interstate relations. Russia supported Nigeria's application for BRICS partner country status . Nigeria has held this status since January 1, 2025, and actively participates in a wide range of events organised by the Association. Cooperation in the humanitarian field is also being stepped up. Russia has increased the number of scholarships awarded to Nigerian students annually .
